evidence.title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents

summary: The evolution of AI is reshaping software design, moving beyond traditional three-tier architecture to a new paradigm centered on storage, models, and autonomous agents. This marks the third major restructuring in software form, reflecting the growing influence of AI systems.
title: AI Drives Shift in Software Architecture: From Three-Tier to Storage, Models, and Agents
